acceptance_criteria: Every P0 screen/flow from the approved brief has traceable, testable acceptance criteria
Pricing, coupon, free-fries-gift, delivery-zone, and tax rules are fully specified
The exact Arabic WhatsApp order-message template and wa.me URL/order-ref format are specified
A single reconciled Egyptian-Arabic menu catalog is produced, every price/asset explicitly labelled owner-confirm
Admin panel scope is defined as a local-browser sandbox (no real backend), with notifications redefined as an in-app announcement bar
Missing business facts (logo, photos, address, hours, zones, socials, real reviews) are tracked as open placeholders, not invented as real
Open decisions and traceability from acceptance criteria to brief phases are recorded
notes: Milestone pivots this repo from Al-Manara (Islamic content platform) to Twister Crepes & Pizza (Arabic RTL restaurant ordering site), per user-approved plan.
Rollback point: git tag almanara-final at commit f4f3a69.

Pre-milestone governance patch (base_ref commit 5819332) added ownership for src/i18n/**, public/**, root dotfiles, and root docs to close gaps that blocked this milestone; fixed the boundary guard to also catch deletions; removed stale religious-governance/scholar wording from product-agent.md and feature-ui-agent.md.
Retirement of old Al-Manara features/routes/domain happens in a reverse sweep after qa-agent acceptance, before release-review-agent, per the approved plan.
Admin panel ships as a local-browser sandbox (localStorage + Export JSON) for this milestone; web push notifications and a real multi-user backend are explicitly deferred to a future milestone.
